provenance.reason: The public dust_clim/dust_cold/dust_warm files are synthetic (the cold case is a minimum reduced by 50 percent, the warm case a maximum increased by 50 percent). The Mars Climate Database full-version terms require the recipient not to transmit the database, in part or in whole, to a third party (https://www-mars.lmd.jussieu.fr/MCD_pro/mcd_pro.html). Those scenarios are not redistributed. The typical map here is the mean of the observational kriged years instead.

The derived MEDA products already in this project (TIRS, wind, pressure, humidity) do not contain dust opacity. RDS optical depth is a radiative-transfer retrieval, not a column in those files. Lemmon et al. 2022 quote an RDS visible peak near 1.7 on the storm, which is not a row in the Mastcam-Z table, so it is cited and not copied in as a measurement.
